## Setup and shared functions

This chunk loads the shared project functions used across the report. These helper functions keep repeated report tasks, such as generating download links and using common formatting choices, consistent across all chromosome 11 haplotype plots.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
source("common.R")
```


## Analysis plotting environment

This chunk prepares the analysis environment for the chromosome 11 haplotype structure workflow. The loaded tools support tidy sample filtering, haplotype rainbow plotting, heatmap-style visualization, and reproducible color palettes used later for site, HRP deletion status, cluster, FWS, and gene-region annotations.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(metan)
library(HaplotypeRainbows)
library(RColorBrewer)


```

## HRP3-deleted monoclonal chromosome 11 haplotype structure

This chunk builds the first chromosome 11 haplotype rainbow plot for samples that are both monoclonal and HRP3-deleted. Monoclonal infections are selected using an FWS threshold of `fws >= 0.95`, HRP3-deleted samples are selected from deletion calls containing `/hrp3-`, and chromosome 11 subregions are restricted to positions at or after `start >= 1954279`. Samples are clustered from haplotype presence/absence profiles using Ward's hierarchical clustering (`ward.D2`), then ordered by HRP deletion category and cluster order before plotting. The resulting plot shows haplotype structure across the selected chromosome 11 duplicated-region subwindows and is saved as `duplicate_region_chr11.pdf`.

```{r}

add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming <-function(rainbow_plot, prepped_allele_data, target_col = "p_name", sample_col = "s_Sample"){
  return(rainbow_plot + 
           scale_x_continuous(
             labels = levels(prepped_allele_data[[target_col]]),
             breaks = 1:n_distinct(levels(prepped_allele_data[[target_col]])),
             expand = c(0,0)
           ) +
           scale_y_continuous(
             labels = levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]]), 
             breaks = 1:n_distinct(levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]])), 
             expand = c(0,0)
           ) + 
           theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), 
                 axis.text.x = element_text(family = "mono", angle = -90, hjust = 0)))
}
#filtering monoclonal samples 

# preparing the hrp3 deleted sample 
sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls <- readr::read_tsv("input/sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", Sample))  %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample))
monoclonal_samples <- sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls%>%
  filter(fws >= 0.95)
hrp3_deleted <- sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls%>%
  filter(grepl("/hrp3-",hrp_deletion_call))


allBasicInfo <- read_tsv("input/all_result_q20/PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allBasicInfo.tab.txt.gz")
allBasicInfo_sel = allBasicInfo %>% 
  mutate(region_name = paste0(`#chrom`, "-", start, "-", end)) %>% 
  select(region_name, sample, perBaseCoverage) %>% 
  mutate(perBaseCoverage = log10(perBaseCoverage + 1)) %>% 
  spread(region_name, perBaseCoverage)
regions_sub_regions_meta = readr::read_tsv("input/all_result_q20/PathWeaverResults/subVarRegions/regions/bed_withGeneInfo.tsv")

regions_sub_regions_meta_chr11_after_pf332 = regions_sub_regions_meta %>% 
  filter(`#chrom` == "Pf3D7_11_v3", 
       start >= 1954279) 
# regions <- read_tsv("C:/Users/ahri2/Desktop/Desktop_2/files/download/Analysis_Surrounding_HRP2_3_deletions/DeletionPatternAnalysis/subwindows_regionMeta.tab.txt")
# 
# regions_afterHomologous_chr11 = regions %>% 
#   filter(`#chrom` == "Pf3D7_11_v3", 
#          afterHomologousRegion)# mutate(name=str_replace(name,"-f.*",""))
# regions_afterHomologous_chr11 = regions_afterHomologous_chr11 %>% 
#   mutate(description = case_when(
#     grepl("extraField0=NA", extraField0) ~ "intergenic", 
#     T ~ gsub("\\]", "", gsub(".*description=", "", extraField0))
#   )  )
# regions_afterHomologous_chr11_filt = regions %>% 
#   filter(name %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$p_name) %>% 
#   mutate(genomicID = factor(genomicID, levels = levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$p_name)))


allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions = readr::read_tsv("input/all_result_q20/PathWeaverResults/subVarRegions/PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allSelectedClustersInfo.tab.txt.gz") %>%
  filter(s_Sample %in% unique(allBasicInfo_sel$sample))
print(length(unique(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions$s_Sample)))

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332 =
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions %>%
  filter(
    p_name %in% regions_sub_regions_meta_chr11_after_pf332$name,
    s_Sample %in% hrp3_deleted$Sample,
    s_Sample %in% monoclonal_samples$Sample
  )

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332 %>% 
  select(s_Sample, h_popUID) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  mutate(marker = 1) %>% 
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp[,2:ncol(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp)])
rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat) = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp$s_Sample
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust = hclust(dist(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat), method = "ward.D2")

chr11_sample_order = tibble(
  s_Sample = rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat)[allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust$order] 
)%>% 
    mutate(chr11_order = 1:nrow(.))

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332)
 
sample_meta_forcluster_data_order = sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls %>% 
  filter(s_Sample %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332$s_Sample) %>% 
  mutate(hrp_deletion_call = factor(hrp_deletion_call, c("hrp2+/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3-", "hrp2+/hrp3-"))) %>% 
  left_join(chr11_sample_order) %>% 
  arrange(hrp_deletion_call, chr11_sample_order)




allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep %>% 
  mutate(s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, 
         levels = intersect(sample_meta_forcluster_data_order$s_Sample, s_Sample)))

print(length(unique(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$s_Sample)))

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep) %>% 
  add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep)

  # print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot)
cairo_pdf("output/figures/duplicate_region_chr11.pdf", width = 30, height = 15)
print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot)
dev.off()
```

## One-unique-haplotype cluster annotated chromosome 11 plot

This chunk focuses on the samples assigned to the one-unique-haplotype chromosome 11 cluster set. It keeps chromosome 11 subregions from the selected region list, filters to samples found in the one-unique-haplotype cluster table, and retains loci represented in nearly all samples using a `sampleCount >= 0.99 * max(sampleCount)` completeness threshold. Samples are clustered with Ward's method from haplotype presence/absence profiles, ordered by HRP deletion category and cluster position, then shown as a rainbow plot with row annotations for collection site, HRP deletion status, and cluster assignment.

```{r}
library(readr)
# unique 1 chormosome haplotype  
jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_1unique_chr11_tib_clusters <- readr::read_tsv("input/jacard_result/jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_1unique_chr11_tib_clusters.txt")

unique_1_cluster <- sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls %>% 
  right_join(jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_1unique_chr11_tib_clusters, by = c("s_Sample" = "sample"))
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions %>%
  filter(
    p_name %in% regions_sub_regions_meta_chr11_after_pf332$name,
    s_Sample %in% unique_1_cluster$s_Sample) %>%   
  group_by(p_name) %>%
  #filter(any(c_AveragedFrac != 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
# make sure the samples number is similar with the hrp3 deleted samples
print(length(unique(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered$p_name)))
# NOW do the clustering and ordering on the filtered data
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered %>%
  group_by(p_name) %>% 
  mutate(sampleCount = length(unique(s_Sample))) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  filter(sampleCount >= 0.99*max(sampleCount)) %>% 
  group_by(s_Sample, p_name) %>% 
  #filter(c_AveragedFrac == max(c_AveragedFrac)) %>% 
  mutate(marker = 1) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  select(h_popUID, marker, s_Sample) %>%   
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp[,2:ncol(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp)])
rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat) = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp$s_Sample
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust = hclust(dist(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat), method = "ward.D2")


# Create sample order from clustered filtered samples
chr11_sample_order = tibble(
  s_Sample = rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat)[
    allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust$order
  ] 
) %>% 
  mutate(chr11_order = 1:nrow(.))

# Prepare metadata with correct sample order
sample_meta_forcluster_data_order = unique_1_cluster %>% 
  filter(s_Sample %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered$s_Sample) %>% 
  mutate(hrp_deletion_call = factor(hrp_deletion_call, 
                                    c("hrp2+/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3+", 
                                      "hrp2-/hrp3-", "hrp2+/hrp3-"))) %>% 
  left_join(chr11_sample_order) %>% 
  arrange(hrp_deletion_call, chr11_sample_order)

# Prepare the data for rainbow plot with correct factor levels
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered
) %>% 
  mutate(s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, 
                          levels = sample_meta_forcluster_data_order$s_Sample))

# Create the plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep
) %>% 
  add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep)


allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "mono", angle = -90, hjust = 0))

# ============================================
# STEP 2: Prepare annotation data
# ============================================
# Get the sample order from your prepared data
sample_order <- levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$s_Sample) 

# Create annotation data frame with y-positions
annotation_data <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order %>%
  filter(s_Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = as.numeric(factor(s_Sample, levels = sample_order))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    site = trimws(as.character(site)),
    hrp_deletion_call = trimws(as.character(hrp_deletion_call))
  ) %>% 
  select(s_Sample, y_position, site, hrp_deletion_call, 
         # Add any other metadata columns you have
          everything())

sample_order <- annotation_data %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  pull(s_Sample)

annotation_data <- annotation_data %>%
  mutate(
    s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, levels = sample_order),
    y_position = as.numeric(s_Sample)
  )
# ============================================
# STEP 3: Define color schemes (automatic)
# ============================================

# Get unique values from your data
 

# Automatically generate colors
unique_sites <- sort(unique(annotation_data$site))

site_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(unique_sites)),
  unique_sites
)

unique_hrp <- sort(unique(annotation_data$hrp_deletion_call))

hrp_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(4, "Set1"))(length(unique_hrp)),
  unique_hrp
)
unique_clusters <- sort(unique(annotation_data$cluster))

cluster_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique_clusters)),
  unique_clusters
)


# ============================================
# STEP 4: Add annotations to the plot
# ============================================

# Define annotation positions (adjust these values as needed)
# xmin, xmax - negative values place bars to the LEFT of main plot
annotation_positions <- list(
  site = c(0, -2.5),
  hrp = c(-3, -5.5),
  cluster = c(-6, -8.5)
)

# Build the annotated plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +

  # Annotation 1: Site information
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$site[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$site[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = site),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Site", values = site_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +

  # Annotation 2: HRP deletion status
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$hrp[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$hrp[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = hrp_deletion_call),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("HRP Status", values = hrp_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +
        ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_rect(
        data = annotation_data,
        aes(
          xmin = annotation_positions$cluster[1],
          xmax = annotation_positions$cluster[2],
          ymin = y_position - 0.5,
          ymax = y_position + 0.5,
          fill = factor(cluster)
        ),
        color = "black",
        size = 0.1
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        "Cluster",
        values = cluster_colors
      ) +

  # Expand the x-axis limits to show the annotations
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-9, NA), clip = "off") +

  # Improve theme for legends
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 60)  # Extra right margin for spacing
  )

# Display the plot
# print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated)


```

## Two-unique-haplotype diverse-locus annotated plot

This chunk analyzes the two-unique-haplotype chromosome 11 cluster set and narrows the plot to loci with strong evidence of within-sample haplotype diversity. It first filters to chromosome 11 subregions and samples from the two-unique-haplotype cluster table, removes loci where all samples have a single averaged fraction, then calculates the proportion of samples with at least two alleles at each locus. Only loci where at least 50 percent of samples are multi-allelic (`prop_multi >= 0.5`) are retained, and loci must also pass the near-complete sample coverage filter (`sampleCount >= 0.99 * max(sampleCount)`). The selected samples are clustered by haplotype presence/absence using Ward's method and plotted with annotations for site, HRP deletion status, and cluster.

```{r}
jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_2unique_chr11_tib_clusters <- readr::read_tsv("input/jacard_result/jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_2unique_chr11_tib_clusters.txt")

unique_2_cluster <- sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls %>% 
  right_join(jacardByHapsTarShared_mat_2unique_chr11_tib_clusters, by = c("s_Sample" = "sample"))
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions %>%
  filter(
    p_name %in% regions_sub_regions_meta_chr11_after_pf332$name,
    s_Sample %in% unique_2_cluster$s_Sample) %>%   
  group_by(p_name) %>%
  filter(any(c_AveragedFrac != 1)) %>%
  ungroup()
allele_counts <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered %>%
  group_by(p_name, s_Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    n_alleles = n_distinct(h_popUID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
locus_diversity <- allele_counts %>%
  group_by(p_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    prop_multi = mean(n_alleles >= 2),
    mean_alleles = mean(n_alleles),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prop_multi))
keep_loci <- locus_diversity %>%
  filter(prop_multi >= 0.5) %>%
  pull(p_name)

filtered_data <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered %>%
  filter(p_name %in% keep_loci)
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered <- filtered_data
# make sure the samples number is similar with the hrp3 deleted samples
print(length(unique(filtered_data$s_Sample)))
# NOW do the clustering and ordering on the filtered data
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp = filtered_data %>%
  group_by(p_name) %>% 
  mutate(sampleCount = length(unique(s_Sample))) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  filter(sampleCount >= 0.99*max(sampleCount)) %>% 
  group_by(s_Sample, p_name) %>% 
  #filter(c_AveragedFrac == max(c_AveragedFrac)) %>% 
  mutate(marker = 1) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  select(h_popUID, marker, s_Sample) %>%   
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp[,2:ncol(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp)])
rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat) = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp$s_Sample
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust = hclust(dist(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat), method = "ward.D2")


# Create sample order from clustered filtered samples
chr11_sample_order = tibble(
  s_Sample = rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat)[
    allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust$order
  ] 
) %>% 
  mutate(chr11_order = 1:nrow(.))

# Prepare metadata with correct sample order
sample_meta_forcluster_data_order = unique_2_cluster %>% 
  filter(s_Sample %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered$s_Sample) %>% 
  mutate(hrp_deletion_call = factor(hrp_deletion_call, 
                                    c("hrp2+/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3+", 
                                      "hrp2-/hrp3-", "hrp2+/hrp3-"))) %>% 
  left_join(chr11_sample_order) %>% 
  arrange(hrp_deletion_call, chr11_sample_order)

# Prepare the data for rainbow plot with correct factor levels
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered
) %>% 
  mutate(s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, 
                          levels = sample_meta_forcluster_data_order$s_Sample))

# Create the plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep
) %>% 
  add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep)


allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "mono", angle = -90, hjust = 0))

# ============================================
# STEP 2: Prepare annotation data
# ============================================
# Get the sample order from your prepared data
sample_order <- levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$s_Sample) 

# Create annotation data frame with y-positions
annotation_data <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order %>%
  filter(s_Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = as.numeric(factor(s_Sample, levels = sample_order))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    site = trimws(as.character(site)),
    hrp_deletion_call = trimws(as.character(hrp_deletion_call))
  ) %>% 
  select(s_Sample, y_position, site, hrp_deletion_call, 
         # Add any other metadata columns you have
          everything())

sample_order <- annotation_data %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  pull(s_Sample)

annotation_data <- annotation_data %>%
  mutate(
    s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, levels = sample_order),
    y_position = as.numeric(s_Sample)
  )
# ============================================
# STEP 3: Define color schemes (automatic)
# ============================================
library(RColorBrewer)

# Get unique values from your data
 

# Automatically generate colors
unique_sites <- sort(unique(annotation_data$site))

site_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(unique_sites)),
  unique_sites
)

unique_hrp <- sort(unique(annotation_data$hrp_deletion_call))

hrp_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(4, "Set1"))(length(unique_hrp)),
  unique_hrp
)
unique_clusters <- sort(unique(annotation_data$cluster))

cluster_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique_clusters)),
  unique_clusters
)


# ============================================
# STEP 4: Add annotations to the plot
# ============================================

# Define annotation positions (adjust these values as needed)
# xmin, xmax - negative values place bars to the LEFT of main plot
annotation_positions <- list(
  site = c(0, -2.5),
  hrp = c(-3, -5.5),
  cluster = c(-6, -8.5)
)
site_mid    <- mean(annotation_positions$site)
hrp_mid     <- mean(annotation_positions$hrp)
cluster_mid <- mean(annotation_positions$cluster)
# Build the annotated plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +

  # Annotation 1: Site information
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$site[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$site[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = site),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Site", values = site_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +

  # Annotation 2: HRP deletion status
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$hrp[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$hrp[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = hrp_deletion_call),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("HRP Status", values = hrp_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +
        ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_rect(
        data = annotation_data,
        aes(
          xmin = annotation_positions$cluster[1],
          xmax = annotation_positions$cluster[2],
          ymin = y_position - 0.5,
          ymax = y_position + 0.5,
          fill = factor(cluster)
        ),
        color = "black",
        size = 0.1
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        "Cluster",
        values = cluster_colors
      ) +

  # Expand the x-axis limits to show the annotations
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-9, NA), clip = "off") +
 annotate(
    "text",
    x = c(site_mid, hrp_mid, cluster_mid),
    y = max(as.numeric(annotation_data$BiologicalSample)) + 1,
    label = c("Site", "HRP", "Cluster"),
    angle = 90,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 10
  ) +

  # Improve theme for legends
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 30, 60)  # Extra right margin for spacing
  )

# Display the plot
```

## Chromosome 11 subwindow gene metadata

This chunk loads the chromosome 11 subwindow metadata and keeps the regions marked as after the homologous region. It also converts the metadata field into a readable region description, assigning `intergenic` when no gene description is present. These descriptions are used later to interpret which chromosome 11 target windows overlap named genes versus intergenic sequence.

```{r}
regions <- readr::read_tsv("input/subwindows_regionMeta.tab.txt")
regions_afterHomologous_chr11 = regions %>% 
  filter(`#chrom` == "Pf3D7_11_v3", 
         afterHomologousRegion)

regions_afterHomologous_chr11 = regions_afterHomologous_chr11 %>% 
  mutate(description = case_when(
    grepl("extraField0=NA", extraField0) ~ "intergenic", 
    T ~ gsub("\\]", "", gsub(".*description=", "", extraField0))
  )  )


```

## Combined unique-cluster chromosome 11 annotated plot

This chunk combines information from the one-unique-haplotype and two-unique-haplotype analyses into a single chromosome 11 visualization. It keeps diverse loci identified from the two-unique-haplotype analysis together with selected one-unique-haplotype regions, restricts cluster groups to those with at least two samples, renames clusters into a consistent sequence, and orders samples by cluster before plotting. The final rainbow plot uses cleaned sample names and includes row annotations for site, HRP deletion status, and cluster, plus a bottom annotation identifying the chromosome 11 target region category.

```{r}
#| echo: false

# ============================================
# FIXED add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming function
# ============================================
add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming <- function(rainbow_plot, prepped_allele_data, target_col = "p_name", sample_col = "Sample") {
  # Check if the sample_col exists in the data, if not use "s_Sample"
  if(!sample_col %in% colnames(prepped_allele_data)) {
    sample_col <- "s_Sample"
    warning(paste0("Column '", sample_col, "' not found. Using 's_Sample' instead."))
  }
  
  return(rainbow_plot + 
           scale_y_continuous(
             labels = levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]]), 
             breaks = 1:n_distinct(levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]])), 
             expand = c(0,0)
           ) + 
           theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono", size = 8), 
                 axis.text.x = element_text(family = "mono", angle = -90, hjust = 0, size = 8)))
}

# ============================================
# MAIN CODE
# ============================================

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions = readr::read_tsv("input/all_result_q20/PathWeaverResults/subVarRegions/PathWeaverResults/reports/populationClustering/reports/allSelectedClustersInfo.tab.txt.gz") %>%
  filter(s_Sample %in% unique(allBasicInfo_sel$sample)) %>% 
    mutate(
    Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", s_Sample),
    Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)
  )

# ============================================
# STEP 1: Process data and create initial plot
# ============================================

unique1_filtered <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions %>%
  filter(
    s_Sample %in% unique_1_cluster$s_Sample,
    p_name %in% keep_loci
  )

filtered_data <- filtered_data %>% 
      mutate(
    Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", s_Sample),
    Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)
  )
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  filtered_data,      # diverse loci
  unique1_filtered
)

print(length(unique(combined_data$s_Sample)))

unique_1_sample_cluster <- unique_1_cluster %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(count = n()) %>%
  filter(count >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_original = paste0("unique1_cluster_", cluster),
    cluster = paste0(
      "U1_C",
      match(
        cluster,
        sort(unique(cluster))
      )
    )
  )

unique_2_sample_cluster <- unique_2_cluster %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(count = n()) %>%
  filter(count >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_original = paste0("unique2_cluster_", cluster),
    cluster = paste0(
      "U2_C",
      match(
        cluster,
        sort(unique(cluster))
      )
    )
  )

merged_unique_cluster <- bind_rows(unique_1_sample_cluster, unique_2_sample_cluster)

# Rename clusters in ascending order
unique_clusters_original <- merged_unique_cluster$cluster %>%
  unique() %>%
  .[order(as.numeric(gsub(".*cluster_", "", .)))]

cluster_rename_map <- setNames(
  paste0("Cluster_", seq_along(unique_clusters_original)),
  unique_clusters_original
)

merged_unique_cluster <- merged_unique_cluster %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_original = cluster,
    cluster = cluster_rename_map[cluster],
    cluster_numeric = as.numeric(gsub(".*cluster_", "", cluster_original))
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster_numeric)

combined_data_cluster <- combined_data %>% 
  filter(s_Sample %in% merged_unique_cluster$s_Sample)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered <- combined_data_cluster

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered %>%
  group_by(p_name) %>% 
  mutate(sampleCount = length(unique(s_Sample))) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  filter(sampleCount >= 0.99*max(sampleCount)) %>% 
  group_by(s_Sample, p_name) %>% 
  mutate(marker = 1) %>% 
  group_by() %>% 
  select(h_popUID, marker, s_Sample) %>%   
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp[,2:ncol(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp)])
rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat) = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp$s_Sample
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust = hclust(dist(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat), method = "ward.D2")

# Create sample order from clustered filtered samples
chr11_sample_order = tibble(
  s_Sample = rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat)[
    allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust$order
  ] 
) %>% 
  mutate(chr11_order = 1:nrow(.))

# ============================================
# STEP 2: Order samples by CLUSTER column
# ============================================

# Prepare metadata with cluster-based ordering
sample_meta_forcluster_data_order = merged_unique_cluster %>% 
  filter(s_Sample %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered$s_Sample) %>% 
  mutate(hrp_deletion_call = factor(hrp_deletion_call, 
                                    c("hrp2+/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3+", 
                                      "hrp2-/hrp3-", "hrp2+/hrp3-"))) %>% 
  left_join(chr11_sample_order) %>% 
  arrange(cluster, chr11_order)

# Create cleaned sample names
# sample_meta_forcluster_data_order <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order %>%
#   mutate(
#     Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", s_Sample),
#     Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample),
#     Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample),
#     Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)
#   )

# Create the sample order vector based on cluster ordering
sample_order_by_cluster <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order$Sample

# Prepare the data for rainbow plot with cluster-based ordering
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep <- 
  HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(
    allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_filtered
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", s_Sample),
    Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order_by_cluster)
  )
  # Create cleaned Sample names as a separate column
  # mutate(
  #   Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", s_Sample),
  #   Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample),
  #   Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample),
  #   Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)
  # ) %>%
  # Set Sample as factor with same order as s_Sample

genRainbowHapPlotObj <- function (prepData, sampleCol = Sample, targetCol = p_name, 
    popUIDCol = h_popUID, relAbundCol = c_AveragedFrac, colorCol = popidFracLogColor, 
    colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")) 
{
    genRainbowHapPlotObjActualFracLogColor(prepData, {
        {
            sampleCol
        }
    }, {
        {
            targetCol
        }
    }, {
        {
            popUIDCol
        }
    }, {
        {
            relAbundCol
        }
    }, {
        {
            colorCol
        }
    }, colors)
}
# Create the plot WITHOUT the auto theming first
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot_base = genRainbowHapPlotObj(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep
)

# Apply custom theming with the Sample column
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming(
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot_base,
  allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep,
  target_col = "p_name",
  sample_col = "Sample"  # Use the cleaned Sample column
)

# ============================================
# STEP 3: Prepare annotation data with cluster ordering
# ============================================

# Get the sample order from your prepared data
sample_order <- levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$Sample)

annotation_data <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order %>%
  filter(Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = as.numeric(
      factor(Sample, levels = sample_order)
    )
  )

# ============================================
# STEP 4: Define color schemes
# ============================================
library(RColorBrewer)

# Get unique values from your data
unique_sites <- sort(unique(annotation_data$site))
site_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(unique_sites)),
  unique_sites
)

unique_hrp <- sort(unique(annotation_data$hrp_deletion_call))
hrp_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(4, "Set1"))(length(unique_hrp)),
  unique_hrp
)

unique_clusters <- unique(annotation_data$cluster_original)
cluster_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique_clusters)),
  unique_clusters
)

# ============================================
# STEP 5: Add row annotations to the plot
# ============================================

# Define annotation positions
annotation_positions <- list(
  site = c(0, -2.5),
  hrp = c(-3, -5.5),
  cluster = c(-6, -8.5)
)

# Build the annotated plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +

  # Annotation 1: Site information
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$site[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$site[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = site),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Site", values = site_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +

  # Annotation 2: HRP deletion status
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$hrp[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$hrp[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = hrp_deletion_call),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("HRP Status", values = hrp_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +
  
  # Annotation 3: Cluster information
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$cluster[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$cluster[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = cluster_original),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Cluster", values = cluster_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top"))

# ============================================
# STEP 6: Add bottom annotations for targets
# ============================================

# Create a proper data frame for the bottom annotation
bottom_annotation_data <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep %>%
  select(p_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    p_name_numeric = as.numeric(factor(p_name, levels = levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$p_name))),
    target = "Chr11_diverse_region"
  )

# Get unique targets and assign colors
unique_target <- sort(unique(bottom_annotation_data$target))
target_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique_target)),
  unique_target
)

# Add the bottom annotation to the plot
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = bottom_annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = p_name_numeric - 0.5,
                xmax = p_name_numeric + 0.5,
                ymax = 0,
                ymin = -3,
                fill = target),
            color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual("Target Region", 
                    values = target_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top")) +
  
  # Adjust coordinate limits to show all annotations
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-9, NA), ylim = c(-3.5, NA), clip = "off") +
  
  # Final theme adjustments
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 50, 60),  # Extra bottom margin for bottom annotation
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = -90, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Display the plot
# print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated)

# Method Used

# The analysis performed in the previous chunk (lines 595‑957) follows these main steps:
# 
# 1. **Filter monoclonal samples** – select samples with `fws >= 0.95` to retain high‑confidence monoclonal isolates.
# 2. **Identify high‑diversity loci** – compute allele diversity per locus and keep loci where the proportion of multi‑allelic samples (`prop_multi`) is ≥ 0.5.
# 3. **Merge unique clusters** – combine the two sets of unique clusters (`unique_1_cluster` and `unique_2_cluster`), rename them sequentially, and create a unified cluster ordering.
# 4. **Cluster samples** – build a haplotype matrix, perform hierarchical clustering (`ward.D2`), and derive a sample order based on the dendrogram.
# 5. **Prepare metadata** – order the sample metadata by cluster and sample order, and add annotation fields (site, HRP deletion status, cluster).
# 6. **Generate rainbow plot** – use `HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj` and `add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming` to create the base plot, then add custom annotations for site, HRP status, and cluster using `ggnewscale` and `geom_rect`.
# 7. **Finalize plot** – adjust axis themes, legend placement, and margins, then display the plot with `print()`.
# 
# The optional `ggsave` call (commented out) can be used to export the annotated plot to a PDF file.

# Optional: Save the plot
```

## Full chromosome 11 region plot for monoclonal samples

This chunk expands the visualization from selected post-PF3D7_11 regions to all chromosome 11 subregions available in the PathWeaver output. It keeps monoclonal samples using the same `fws >= 0.95` threshold, standardizes sample names across metadata and haplotype calls, clusters samples by chromosome 11 haplotype presence/absence with Ward's method, and orders them by HRP deletion status and site. The plot adds side annotations for site, HRP deletion status, and continuous FWS values, plus a bottom annotation showing the gene or intergenic label for each chromosome 11 target window.

```{r}
#| echo: false
# script used for plotting all of the chromosome 11 region and all of the samples so i need to annotate the samples without using a cluster 
add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming <-function(rainbow_plot, prepped_allele_data, target_col = "p_name", sample_col = "s_Sample"){
  return(rainbow_plot + 
           # scale_x_continuous(
           #   labels = levels(prepped_allele_data[[target_col]]),
           #   breaks = 1:n_distinct(levels(prepped_allele_data[[target_col]])),
           #   expand = c(0,0)
           # ) +
           scale_y_continuous(
             labels = levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]]), 
             breaks = 1:n_distinct(levels(prepped_allele_data[[sample_col]])), 
             expand = c(0,0)
           ) + 
           theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), 
                 axis.text.x = element_text(family = "mono", angle = -90, hjust = 0)))
}

  )

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332 %>% 
  select(s_Sample, h_popUID) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  mutate(marker = 1) %>% 
  spread(h_popUID, marker, fill = 0)
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat = as.matrix(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp[,2:ncol(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp)])
rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat) = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp$s_Sample
allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust = hclust(dist(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat), method = "ward.D2")

chr11_sample_order = tibble(
  s_Sample = rownames(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_mat)[allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332_sp_hclust$order] 
)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = HaplotypeRainbows::prepForRainbow(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332)
 
sample_meta_forcluster_data_order = sample_meta_with_hrp2_3_calls %>% 
  filter(Sample %in% allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_chr11_after_pf332$s_Sample) %>% 
  mutate(hrp_deletion_call = factor(hrp_deletion_call, c("hrp2+/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3+", "hrp2-/hrp3-", "hrp2+/hrp3-"))) %>% 
  left_join(chr11_sample_order,by=c("Sample"="s_Sample")) %>% 
  arrange(hrp_deletion_call,site)%>% 
    mutate(chr11_order = 1:nrow(.))




allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep = allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep %>% 
  mutate(s_Sample = factor(s_Sample, 
         levels = intersect(sample_meta_forcluster_data_order$Sample, s_Sample)))

print(length(unique(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$s_Sample)))

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot = HaplotypeRainbows::genRainbowHapPlotObj(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep) %>% 
  add_haplotype_rainbow_axis_theming(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep)

bottom_annotation_data <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep %>%
  select(p_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    p_name_numeric = as.numeric(factor(p_name, levels = levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$p_name))),
    target = "Chr11_diverse_region"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(regions_sub_regions_meta_chr11_after_pf332 %>% select(name,Name) ,by=c("p_name"="name"))

bottom_annotation_data$Name[is.na(bottom_annotation_data$Name)] <- "intergenic"
# Get unique targets and assign colors
unique_target <- sort(unique(bottom_annotation_data$Name))
target_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set3"))(length(unique_target)),
  unique_target
)

sample_order <- levels(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_prep$s_Sample)

annotation_data <- sample_meta_forcluster_data_order %>%
  filter(Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = as.numeric(
      factor(Sample, levels = sample_order)
    )
  )

# Get unique values from your data
unique_sites <- sort(unique(annotation_data$site))
site_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(unique_sites)),
  unique_sites
)

unique_hrp <- sort(unique(annotation_data$hrp_deletion_call))
hrp_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(4, "Set1"))(length(unique_hrp)),
  unique_hrp
)

unique_clusters <- unique(annotation_data$fws)
cluster_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(length(unique_clusters)),
  unique_clusters
)

annotation_positions <- list(
  site = c(0, -4),
  hrp = c(-5, -9),
  fws = c(-10, -14)
)

allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated <- allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_plot +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$site[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$site[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = site),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("Site", values = site_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +

  # Annotation 2: HRP deletion status
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = annotation_positions$hrp[1], 
                xmax = annotation_positions$hrp[2],
                ymin = y_position - 0.5, 
                ymax = y_position + 0.5, 
                fill = hrp_deletion_call),
            color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual("HRP Status", values = hrp_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top")) +
    # Annotation 3: fws information
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
            geom_rect(
            data = annotation_data,
            aes(
              xmin = annotation_positions$fws[1],
              xmax = annotation_positions$fws[2],
              ymin = y_position - 0.5,
              ymax = y_position + 0.5,
              fill = fws
            ),
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 0.1
          ) +
          scale_fill_gradient(
            name = "FWS",
            low = "white",
            high = "darkred"
          )+
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_rect(data = bottom_annotation_data,
            aes(xmin = p_name_numeric - 0.5,
                xmax = p_name_numeric + 0.5,
                ymax = 0,
                ymin = -3,
                fill = Name),
            color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual("Target Region", 
                    values = target_colors,
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top")) +
  
  # Adjust coordinate limits to show all annotations
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-9, NA), ylim = c(-3.5, NA), clip = "off") +
  
  # Final theme adjustments
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 50, 60),  # Extra bottom margin for bottom annotation
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = -90, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
  # print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated)
cairo_pdf("output/figures/duplicate_region_chr11_all_region.pdf", width = 30, height = 15)
print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated)
dev.off()
```
## Download full chromosome 11 region plot

This chunk adds a download link for the full chromosome 11 annotated rainbow plot PDF. This exported version is useful for inspecting the dense all-region figure outside the HTML page.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(createDownloadLink("output/figures/duplicate_region_chr11_all_region.pdf"))
```
## Display full chromosome 11 region plot

This chunk displays the full chromosome 11 annotated rainbow plot in the report. The large figure size is used because this view contains all available chromosome 11 subregions, many monoclonal samples, and multiple annotation tracks.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 20

print(allSelectedClustersInfo_sub_regions_annotated, merge_legends = T, background = "transparent")
```
